text:
leo: FYI cutting a small rollout at 16:00 UTC for api v2.2.0 + runtime v3.0.1. targeting canary lane only. putting console and router unchanged. deploy-bot has the window. @anya @jasmin

deploy-bot: Deploy window allocated: 2026-06-10T16:00Z->16:45Z. Canary progression: 3% 8m -> 15% 12m -> 60% 10m. Auto-rollback: 5xx rate >3% for 3m OR schema mismatch alerts.

anya: ack api pin v2.2.0. i'll watch schema logs and gateway validation.

jasmin: runtime ack. console/router unchanged. standing by for header swap.

leo: adding short rollback playbook to release notes: 1) stop canary (router) 2) pin api to previous stable v2.1.9 3) reroute canary traffic back 4) open incident if >10% customer impact

deploy-bot: Canary started: api=v2.2.0 -> 3% at 16:00:00 UTC. Telemetry: 5xx, upstream schema validator, p50 stable.

(16:06 UTC) deploy-bot: Alert -> increase in 502/503s from edge: 5xx rate 4.8% over 3m. Reason: gateway schema mismatch detected by validation service.

anya: seeing spike in gateway logs: rejected payloads with new field `trace_context` causing adapter errors. will tail validation traces.

jasmin: hold on runtime ops — looks isolated to API layer, not runtime. we can rollback API only.

leo: ok. can we pin back to v2.1.9 and abort canary? who runs the pin?

anya: i'll run the pin and stop traffic shift. routerctl hold and apictl pin in that order. commands:
```
routerctl stop-shift --wave=canary-1749998888
apictl pin --service=api --version=v2.1.9 --reason="schema mismatch rollback"
```
I'll execute both.

deploy-bot: Canary at 3% aborted, holding traffic. Waiting for operator actions.

(16:09 UTC) anya: ran `routerctl stop-shift` -> confirmed. running `apictl pin --service=api --version=v2.1.9` now.

deploy-bot: api pinned to v2.1.9 by anya at 16:10:12 UTC. Re-deploy triggered: api rollback job queued.

leo: nice. jasmin, watch runtime & console but don't change anything.

jasmin: watching. no OOMs or latency change in runtime. looks api-only.

deploy-bot: api rollback job complete, pods replaced with v2.1.9. Health checks passing. Edge 5xxs falling.

(16:14 UTC) deploy-bot: Post-rollback metrics: 5xx rate dropped to 0.6% over 5m, p50 unchanged. Canary wave marked PARTIAL_ROLLBACK (api) by leo.

leo: posting short support note and release update. drafters: "We halted API canary due to schema validation failures caused by an unexpected `trace_context` field in requests. API reverted to v2.1.9 while we patch the validator and add a compat shim."

anya: opened BUG-2201: api-schema-adapter. attaching validation traces and sample payloads. tagging api-team + gateway.

jasmin: will schedule a follow-up canary with api v2.2.0 once shim is in place. propose adding a lightweight schema-gate in preflight.

leo: agreed. action items: anya deploy shim in staging + run schema-gate; jasmin coordinate next canary; i will update release notes and close wave.

deploy-bot: Wave summary: wave=1749998888 -> PARTIAL_ROLLBACK at 16:14:18 UTC. Affected: API only. Operators: leo, anya, jasmin. Canary duration ~14m. Trigger: validation failures -> 5xx spike.

anya: retro note: add a quick compatibility test for new fields in edge-simulator before enabling any api feature that touches request surface.

leo: adding to retro board. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

(END)
